$comment: Raster gameplay sprites. Replaces canvas-primitive drawing with real art. nano_banana (1 credit) + image_background_remover (1 credit) = 2 credits per sprite. Run: node scripts/gen-assets.mjs docs/sprite-manifest.json [--only <substr>]. Then: node scripts/optimize-assets.mjs <dir> <files>

defaults.style_suffix: Polished semi-realistic mobile game art with clean cel shading and a crisp readable silhouette. Single warm key light from the upper left with a cool ambient fill. Warm cream, gold and amber tones against deep navy. Centered, isolated subject, plain flat mid-grey background. No text, no lettering, no logos, no user interface, no scenery, no drop shadow.
